item.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
item.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Binance, Polymarket seek Polygon hard fork to recover $6.8M in stolen crypto
item.description: Polygon block producers have already frozen the stolen tokens, but a proposed hard fork would allow the funds to be recovered and returned to their owners.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: ‘Lawyer up’: Democrats target Trump, Big Tech after midterm sweep
item.description: Democrats wasted little time after their midterm victory, warning tech CEOs to prepare for subpoenas and signaling fresh investigations into Trump’s business dealings.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: India warns AI-powered hackers targeting crypto exchanges at ‘machine speed’
item.description: India’s cybersecurity agency says a threat actor is escalating an AI-assisted hacking campaign targeting crypto exchanges and other financial firms.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Mercado Bitcoin says phased reopening to begin Monday, will cover losses
item.description: Customers will initially be able to view their holdings, while withdrawals and trading remain suspended pending security checks.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: BitMart founder says security team ‘severely understaffed’ after new hack
item.description: The crypto exchange’s founder warned of security staffing shortages amid restructuring as analysts flagged suspicious transfers potentially linked to the Mercado Bitcoin hack.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Crypto PACs eye 2028 ‘new map’ as Democrats take Congress
item.description: Crypto super PACs spent more than $176 million on the midterms, but the Democratic sweep raises the prospect of tougher industry scrutiny.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Isabelle Castro

item.title: How Aussie Bitcoiners can avoid 2027’s shock CGT hike
item.description: From setting up an SMSF or a company, to just leaving the country entirely, here are some strategies Australian Bitcoiners can employ to deal with 2027’s massive CGT hike.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Andrew Fenton

item.title: Trump-linked tokens lead crypto losses after Democrats sweep in the US midterms
item.description: The official Trump and World Liberty Financial tokens were the two biggest losers among the top 100 cryptocurrencies on Wednesday, even as Bitcoin and Ether rallied.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Jona Jaupi

item.title: Riot shares surge on $28B AI lease as Hut 8 sinks on revenue miss
item.description: Bitcoin miner Riot sold BTC to finance its AI expansion, while Hut 8 reported falling revenue and rising costs before its major data center leases generate income.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Circle’s ARC token sale lifts earnings as lower yields weigh on USDC income
item.description: Circle is looking to payments fees and future staking rewards to diversify revenue as its core stablecoin business faces pressure from lower yields and growing competition.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph

item.title: Bitcoin hits $80.5K as US stocks rally on midterm election results
item.description: Bitcoin climbed toward $80,500 as risk assets rallied on Democrats’ midterm election gains and oil prices fell.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: France backs reporting for self-custodied crypto worth 100K euros or more
item.description: The amendment would require taxpayers to report holdings worth at least $112,000, but the measure still needs to survive the budget process.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Canton’s CC rises 4% as SEC staff view it as ‘digital commodity’
item.description: SEC staff’s no-action letter covers CC earned by running infrastructure and applications, but is not a binding ruling on its legal status.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Binance hack may be ‘temporary setback’ for crypto, Grayscale’s Pandl says
item.description: Zach Pandl highlighted institutional custody safeguards as crypto markets recovered some losses following the record $6.3 billion Binance hack.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Justin Sun seeks $264K sanctions over World Liberty’s UAE disclosure
item.description: Sun plans to refile his token-freeze lawsuit in California state court after the sanctions motion is resolved. A hearing is set for Dec. 10.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Bitcoin ETFs lose $1.16B as Bitwise calls selling ‘short-term’
item.description: Bitwise’s André Dragosch attributed Bitcoin ETF outflows to weaker market sentiment, saying institutions have largely maintained their exposure.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: US midterm elections 2026 as it happened: Democrats win control of Congress
item.description: Democrats won control of Congress in the 2026 US midterms. Catch up on key races, crypto-backed candidates and the outlook for crypto regulation.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Binance hackers move 81% of stolen Solana, route funds via THORChain
item.description: The Binance attackers moved most of the stolen SOL and continued laundering funds through THORChain after the protocol resumed swaps.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Democrats win US House to secure control of Congress in midterms
item.description: Democrats will take control of House committees in January 2027, giving them power to investigate President Donald Trump’s administration.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Bitcoin bounces from 7-week low under $76K as Democrats sweep Congress
item.description: Bitcoin price downside reached a seven-week-low of $75,618 as 24-hour crypto long liquidations neared $300 million.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Ethereum dev targets 2028 for quantum resistance, a year early
item.description: Ethereum researcher Justin Drake said it is their “hope” that Ethereum will achieve its post-quantum and post-AI transition by December 2028.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Democrats claim control of the US Senate
item.description: The shift in Senate control could change the path for the CLARITY Act, reshape committee leadership and bring closer scrutiny of Trump’s crypto businesses.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: ZachXBT identifies French bank as alleged victim of $133M crypto theft
item.description: The French bank has not confirmed its alleged involvement in the crypto theft, which ZachXBT said could have resulted in losses exceeding $133 million.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: 1inch lawyer sees agencies driving US crypto regulation as midterms unfold
item.description: Crypto executives expect US regulators to drive crypto policymaking regardless of the midterm election outcome.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: RUNE rallies 15% as THORChain restarts most swaps after halt
item.description: THORChain has restored trading on Bitcoin, Ethereum and several other networks following a refund bug, while three chains remain paused.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: SpaceX blocks tokenized stock listing on OKXICE despite offshore trading boom
item.description: SpaceX joined several other issuers objecting to OKXICE tokenized trading, months after crypto platforms offered tokens tied to its shares.

item.title: CFTC clears stock perpetual futures for trading on US exchanges
item.description: US regulators are opening the door to stock-based perpetual futures, extending a popular crypto trading product into traditional markets amid ongoing legal disputes.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: US midterms: Prediction markets favor Democrats in key crypto races
item.description: Kalshi and Polymarket price a 75% chance of a Democratic sweep, days after markets misjudged Brazil’s runoff.

item.title: Wall Street killed Bitcoin’s wild rallies: 10x’s Markus Thielen
item.description: Markus Thielen sees Bitcoin reaching $90,000 by year-end, questions institutional ETF demand and says Ethereum must do more for holders.
